newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - THREE PERCENT OF ESS SHARES SOLD IN AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - THREE PERCENT OF ESS SHARES SOLD IN AUCTION.

text.p: Local investors bought three percent of shares in Estonian security market leader ESS in an auction on Thursday, Hoiupank Investments said.
The equilibrium price of a share with a 10 kroon par value was 75.1 kroons, project leader of Hoiupank Investments, Raul Hindov, told Reuters.
Hindov added that 14 offers were submitted and 30,000 shares were sold in two blocks.
The minimum price of the shares was 65 kroons. The price of its recent share issue was 57 kroons.
Some 33 percent of the company's shares are now in public hands.
ESS is seeking a listing on the secondary list of the Tallinn bourse.
